plants.name: Tulipa gesneriana
plants.description: Cup-shaped blooms in saturated jewel tones rise on sturdy stems above blue-green leaves. They make dazzling stripes of color across fields and flowerbeds. In the Netherlands, the fields near Lisse and the Keukenhof gardens are at or near their peak around the start of May.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid-April to early May in the Netherlands, with the peak usually in mid-to-late April
plants.funFact: In the 1630s, tulip bulbs were so prized in the Netherlands that single bulbs reportedly sold for more than the price of a house during the period known as tulip mania.

plants.name: Wisteria floribunda
plants.description: Long, fragrant chains of pea-like flowers hang from twining woody vines and form lilac curtains over pergolas and temple gardens. In Japan, famous wisteria trellises, such as those in Tochigi and Fukuoka, reach full bloom in late April and early May.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late April to mid-May in Japan
plants.funFact: Japanese wisteria twines clockwise, while Chinese wisteria twines counterclockwise. Old vines can grow for well over a century and develop trunks as thick as a tree's.

plants.name: Cardamine pratensis
plants.description: Pale lilac flowers float above damp meadows, riverbanks and woodland edges in loose, airy clusters. They appear around the time the cuckoo returns in spring, and they are a favorite nectar source for early butterflies.
plants.bloomingSeason: April to June in Europe, with flowering widespread across the British Isles in early May
plants.location: Damp meadows and verges across the British Isles and Europe
plants.funFact: Cuckooflower is a key larval food plant for the orange-tip butterfly, whose females lay their eggs on its flower stalks.
